verdict.rationale: Luma offers a video and image generation API, and asynchronous generation APIs commonly offer outbound HTTP callbacks, so the webhooks axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack documents registrable webhooks, a callback URL parameter, or event subscriptions. The API docs cover endpoints, SDKs, credits, versioning and the absence of a sandbox, but never outbound event delivery.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
